a rural district of North Rhine-Westphalia; seat: Meschede

Hochschulreife.et: 19th century, Hochschule + Reife, if at some point meant formally then translating the foreignist Maturität in compounds.

s: university graduate, someone who is about to finish uni

Höchstberg.et: By surface analysis, höchst- (“highest”) + Berg (“mountain”). Cognate with Alemannic German Hegschberch for the Baden-Württemberg sense.

s: high time (state of extreme urgency after having delayed something important for almost too long)
Sind noch Punkte offen, ist es jetzt "höchste Eisenbahn" zu vereinbaren, wie damit weiterverfahren werden soll.
If there is anything not yet settled, now is "high time" to agree on how to deal with it going forward.
Mein lieber Freund, das war wirklich höchste Eisenbahn, das war verdammt knapp, einige Stunden später und Sie hätten nie mehr einen Fuß vor den anderen setzen können.
Good lord, that was truly in the nick of time, that was damn close, a few hours later and you'd never have been able to walk again.
höchste Eisenbahn.et: Literally, “highest train”. Apparently from a malapropism used in a 1847 theater play by Adolf Glassbrenner.

s: high price; peak (the highest price level reached by a security or currency within a defined period)

This imposter impersonated a doctor.

I know Tom is a con artist.
Woher weiß ich, dass Sie kein Hochstapler sind?
How do I know you're not an imposter?

Der Film "Bekenntnisse des Hochstaplers Thomas Mann"

t: Das Warnschild besagt: Hochspannung! Vorsicht! Lebensgefahr!
The sign warns: "Danger – High Voltage".
